text.tspan: Measures 108–121: Large descending sequence and its continuation into the next harmonic passage.
Practice 108–110, 111–113, 114–116, and 117–121. Keep 118–121 intact: Bach writes a continuous chain of slurs across 118→119→120→121.
Measures 118–128: Slurred lead-in to the compressed harmonic-rhythm passage.
Start at 118 so the complete slur chain 118→119→120→121 is preserved. The core practice groups are 121–122, 123–124, 125–126, and 127–128.
Measures 129–136: Final sequential and cadential progression back to G minor.
Practice 129–133 and 134–136, then play 129–136 as one uninterrupted arrival at the final tonic.
